Container.Name: honeygain-claimer
Container.Overview: Dockerized, cron-scheduled fork of binhake/honeygain. Runs the project's single-run claim script (src/action.js) on a cron schedule inside the container instead of a long-running process or GitHub Actions, so it claims your daily Honeygain Lucky Pot automatically. Optionally sends a Telegram notification when a pot is claimed.

Config.Name: HONEYGAIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Your Honeygain account email. Required unless using HONEYGAIN_TOKEN.

Config.Name: HONEYGAIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Your Honeygain account password. Required unless using HONEYGAIN_TOKEN.

Config.Name: HONEYGAIN_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional: a pre-obtained auth token, used instead of email/password.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional: Telegram Bot API token for claim notifications.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
Config.Description: Optional: Telegram chat ID to send notifications to.

Config.Name: CRON_SCHEDULE
Config.Description: Standard 5-field cron expression for how often to run the claim script.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone the CRON_SCHEDULE above is evaluated in, e.g. America/New_York.

Config.Name: RUN_ON_START
Config.Description: Run one claim immediately when the container starts, in addition to the cron schedule. true or false.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Stores the cached Honeygain access token so it survives container restarts and updates instead of logging in with email/password every run.
